strings.name: Reinhard Genzel
strings.summary: Genzel trained in Bonn, worked in the United States and led a team at MPE. Combining infrared instruments with stellar orbit measurements, he helped establish a supermassive compact object at the Galactic centre and studied galaxy evolution. He shared the 2020 physics Nobel with Penrose and Ghez; the observations were collaborative.
strings.influence.rationale: Studies the Galactic centre through infrared astronomy, advancing understanding of supermassive black holes and galaxy evolution.
strings.facts.f2.value: Doctorate, University of Bonn (1978), with research at the Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Tracking Galactic-centre stars
strings.highlights.h1.text: Long-term orbital observations by the team constrained the central compact object’s mass.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Testing relativity
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participated in GRAVITY observations of relativistic effects in star S2 near the black hole.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Spectroscopy medal
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received the 2026 Ioannes Marcus Marci Medal for high-resolution spectroscopy.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Shared Nobel Prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the physics prize with Penrose and Ghez, honoured for Galactic-centre compact-object observations.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Observed gravitational redshift
strings.timeline.t3.text: The collaboration reported S2’s gravitational redshift, consistent with general relativity.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Leibniz Prize
strings.timeline.t4.text: Received the DFG Leibniz Prize, supporting continued research.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became MPE director
strings.timeline.t5.text: Returned to Germany as an MPE director and scientific member.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Berkeley faculty
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined Berkeley’s physics faculty, researching astronomical observations and instrumentation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed doctoral research in Bonn, then moved to Harvard-Smithsonian astrophysics.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Bad Homburg
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Bad Homburg; later studied physics in Freiburg and Bonn.
